messages:
monica: Quick sync: finalize owners for v1->v2 deprecation docs. Need migration guide, SDK snippet rename (client.call -> client.invoke), embed model swap note + 30-day alias fallback, redirects and banner. Banner scheduled 2026-04-07.
jared: I'll take JS/TS snippets and CHANGELOG entries. Will open small PRs per package.
priya: I'll finish migration guide and add Before/After blocks + rollback FAQ.
emily: I'll handle redirects and banner copy; need old paths and the support blurb.
sean: streaming framing changed; I'll paste a short example for guide and run snippet tests on staging.
docs-bot: CI started for docs/migration-248130. status: in_progress.
monica: Action list: jared -> snippets; priya -> guide; emily -> redirects/banner; sean -> streaming example/tests. Also: provide JS + Python embed migration snippets and the support blurb for support.
jared: sample quick patch I'll apply: // BEFORE: await client.call({ model: "redwood/v1-chat", input: "Hi" }); // AFTER: await client.invoke({ model: "redwood/v2-chat", prompt: "Hi" });
sean: streaming example to include: // v1: for await (const c of client.stream("v1-chat", p)) {} // v2: for await (const e of client.streamEvents({model:"v2-chat", prompt:p})) { if (e.type=="delta") ... }
priya: embed note: recommend "embed-lite-v2"; map "embed-1" -> "embed-lite-v2" for 30 days. I'll add to FAQ and checklist.
emily: support blurb candidate: "Requests to 'embed-1' will be routed to 'embed-lite-v2' for 30 days after the deprecation banner. Please migrate to 'embed-lite-v2'." OK?
monica: yes. Once PRs land, ping #announcements and #support. emily, schedule banner for 2026-04-06 09:00 PT to go live a day before emails.
docs-bot: docs build passed for branch docs/migration-248130 at 2481301700.
monica: thanks everyone — I'll send an exec one-pager after lunch and track open PRs in the migration guide checklist. :thumbsup:
